subject: Conditional quarterly remit with early-pay discount — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Harvest Systems — request: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 ask + early-pay discount (attachments)

Team,

Quick context: Harvest Systems (Prod & Platform) wants to sign but procurement is pushing for a consolidated quarterly invoice with a Net-90 payment term. They’re a strategic ARR opportunity (~$1.2M ARR) and have asked for a one-time commercial concession: quarterly invoicing + Net-90, and an early-pay discount (2.5% if paid within 15 days). They also asked for a 10% standard discount in exchange for the extended terms.

Deal desk reviewed and recommended: quarterly invoicing OK; do NOT approve Net-90 as a default. Recommended options: (A) approve quarterly invoicing + Net-60, and offer a 2.5% early-pay discount; (B) approve Net-90 only as a time-limited pilot (first 6 months) with ACH mandate + 25% initial prepay; discount capped at 7%.

Attachments: Harvest_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with milestones) and payment_schedule_proposal.xlsx (customer-proposed schedule).

Ask: Exec sign-off on a path forward. Customer deadline for contracting is next Friday 8/19. My recommended motion: approve Option B (6-month Net-90 pilot conditional on ACH mandate and 25% initial prepay) and cap discount at 7%. This preserves the sale while protecting cash risk.

Notes: If we approve full Net-90 without conditioning, we'd need a finance pre-approval for bad-debt reserve and to flag collections for weekly cadence.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harvest Systems — request: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 ask + early-pay discount (attachments)

+1 to Neha’s recommendation. Quick commercial take from Sales: Harvest is strategic in the mid-market vertical we want to win; risk is non-trivial but manageable. My preference is Option B with these clarifications:
- Approve Net-90 as a 6-month pilot only (automatic revert to Net-60 thereafter).
- Require ACH mandate and a signed payment schedule in the SOW (we should add Contract Appendix A).
- Limit discount to 7% (not 10%) and mark this as a one-time customer success concession recorded in the deal notes.

If Finance is comfortable with the 25% initial prepay, I’ll push legal to draft the Appendix and we can attach DocuSign for faster turnaround.

Karthik
Head of Sales — West

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harvest Systems — payment term request (finance perspective)

Thanks for pulling this together, Neha. From Finance side a few concerns:
- Cashflow impact: $1.2M ARR with Net-90 and quarterly invoicing increases DSO materially and would push our working capital burden for Q3/Q4.
- Credit exposure: Harvest has a decent profile but procurement is known for slow cycles; we should limit exposure.

Finance suggested mitigations if Leadership wants to move forward:
1) Approve quarterly invoicing for the term but require an ACH mandate and automated payment instructions;
2) Require a 25% initial prepay on signature (applied to first invoice);
3) If Net-90 is granted, cap it to the first two quarters only and require the customer to enroll in electronic invoicing and auto-pay. After two quarters, auto-revert to Net-60 unless collections performance meets metrics (on-time > 95%).

If Leadership prefers a stronger protection, we can approve only Net-60 + 2.5% early-pay discount.

Please mark this for exec decision — Finance will implement controls once we have approval.

— Jonas
VP Finance Operations

Laura — looping you for final sign-off. Below is a short summary and the two options for your approval. Customer needs contractual terms by EOD 8/19 to hit their internal procurement window.

Summary: Harvest Systems (DEAL-9234) requests quarterly invoicing + Net-90 + 10% discount. Deal desk recommends Option B with protections. Sales supports Option B; Finance requests ACH mandate + 25% initial prepay and an automatic reversion to Net-60 after two quarters unless collections criteria are met.

Options for Laura’s approval (please reply with the option number and any conditions):
1) Approve Option A: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 + 2.5% early-pay discount (no prepay).
2) Approve Option B (recommended): Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for first two quarters only (automatic revert to Net-60), require ACH mandate + 25% initial prepay, cap discount at 7%.
3) Decline concessions: require standard Net-60 / monthly invoicing.

Attachments are included again for reference (SOW and customer payment schedule). Forwarding below for context.

Thanks,
Neha
